citation.holdings: KS-01-25-065, Annex 1 – Model questionnaire (ICT-ENT 2025 V1.5), Module E "Artificial Intelligence" (Eurostat)

stdyInfo.abstract: This study contains only Module E (Artificial Intelligence) of the Eurostat model questionnaire for the 2025 EU survey on ICT usage and e-commerce in enterprises, as printed in the 2025 compilers' manual; national statistical institutes adapt it for their own surveys. The enterprise reports which AI technologies it uses, for which business purposes, and how it acquired the AI software or systems. Enterprises not using AI are asked whether they ever considered it and, if so, why they do not use it (for example costs, lack of expertise, data protection concerns or unclear legal consequences).

sumDscr.universe: Enterprises with 10 or more employees and self-employed persons (NACE Rev. 2 sections C–J, L–N and group 95.1; optional: 0–9). Module E: enterprises with access to the internet.

qstn.preQTxt: Does your enterprise use any of the following Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies?
qstn.qstnLit: a) AI technologies performing analysis of written language (e.g. text mining)
qstn.postQTxt: Text mining refers to the use of advanced techniques for automated detection of patterns in (large) texts.

qstn.preQTxt: Does your enterprise use any of the following Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies?
qstn.qstnLit: b) AI Technologies converting spoken language into machine-readable format (speech recognition)
qstn.postQTxt: Speech recognition is the ability of a machine or program to identify words and phrases in spoken language and convert them to a machine-readable format.

qstn.preQTxt: Does your enterprise use any of the following Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies?
qstn.qstnLit: c) AI Technologies generating written or spoken language (natural language generation, speech synthesis)
qstn.postQTxt: Natural language generation is the ability for a computer program to convert data into natural language representation.

qstn.preQTxt: Does your enterprise use any of the following Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies?
qstn.qstnLit: d) AI Technologies generating pictures, videos, sound/audio

qstn.preQTxt: Does your enterprise use any of the following Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies?
qstn.qstnLit: e) AI Technologies identifying objects or persons based on images or videos (image recognition, image processing)

qstn.preQTxt: Does your enterprise use any of the following Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies?
qstn.qstnLit: f) Machine learning (e.g. deep learning) for data analysis
qstn.postQTxt: Machine learning (e.g. deep learning) involves ‘training’ a computer model to better perform an automated task, e.g. pattern recognition.

qstn.preQTxt: Does your enterprise use any of the following Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies?
qstn.qstnLit: g) AI Technologies automating different workflows or assisting in decision making (e.g. AI based software robotic process automation)
qstn.postQTxt: Artificial Intelligence based robotic process automation refers to software that automates business processes (e.g. workflows automation) based on Artificial Intelligence technologies.

qstn.preQTxt: Does your enterprise use any of the following Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies?
qstn.qstnLit: h) AI Technologies enabling physical movement of machines via autonomous decisions based on observation of surroundings (autonomous robots, self-driving vehicles, autonomous drones)
